requirements.title: Floating-point modes and status terms identify the stored state sets
requirements.definition: The rounding modes, underflow mode, and halting mode are collectively the floating-point modes; all supported exception flags plus those modes are collectively the floating-point status.

requirements.title: IEEE_MODES_TYPE stores and restores floating-point modes
requirements.definition: Floating-point modes can be stored in a scalar IEEE_MODES_TYPE variable by IEEE_GET_MODES and restored by IEEE_SET_MODES.

pending.ieee-modes-type-scalar-storage: Compile-time plan: declare a scalar IEEE_MODES_TYPE variable, call IEEE_GET_MODES on it, and use it as the sole argument to IEEE_SET_MODES; mutate the variable to an array to reject through ordinary interface checking owned elsewhere.
pending.ieee-get-set-modes-round-trip: Three guarded branches, one per floating-point mode component. Rounding branch probes IEEE_SUPPORT_ROUNDING(IEEE_NEAREST,0.0) and IEEE_SUPPORT_ROUNDING(IEEE_TO_ZERO,0.0), sets IEEE_NEAREST, saves modes, sets IEEE_TO_ZERO, restores modes, and asserts IEEE_GET_ROUNDING_MODE returns IEEE_NEAREST. Underflow branch probes IEEE_SUPPORT_UNDERFLOW_CONTROL(0.0), sets GRADUAL=.TRUE., saves modes, sets GRADUAL=.FALSE., restores modes, and asserts IEEE_GET_UNDERFLOW_MODE returns .TRUE. Halting branch probes IEEE_SUPPORT_HALTING(IEEE_OVERFLOW), sets halting .FALSE., saves modes, performs a second .FALSE. set, restores modes, and asserts IEEE_GET_HALTING_MODE returns .FALSE.; unsupported branches record skip.

requirements.title: IEEE_STATUS_TYPE stores and restores floating-point status as a whole
requirements.definition: Floating-point status can be stored in a scalar IEEE_STATUS_TYPE variable by IEEE_GET_STATUS and restored by IEEE_SET_STATUS; no facility reveals particular flags represented by such a variable.

pending.ieee-status-type-scalar-storage: Compile-time plan: declare a scalar IEEE_STATUS_TYPE variable, call IEEE_GET_STATUS on it, and use it as the sole argument to IEEE_SET_STATUS; mutate the variable to an array to reject through ordinary interface checking owned elsewhere.
pending.ieee-get-set-status-round-trip: Guarded branches pair one exception flag with one mode in each IEEE_GET_STATUS/IEEE_SET_STATUS round trip. Rounding-status branch probes IEEE_SUPPORT_FLAG(IEEE_OVERFLOW,0.0), IEEE_SUPPORT_ROUNDING(IEEE_NEAREST,0.0), and IEEE_SUPPORT_ROUNDING(IEEE_TO_ZERO,0.0); supported branch clears IEEE_OVERFLOW and sets IEEE_NEAREST, saves status, sets the flag signaling and rounding IEEE_TO_ZERO, restores status, then asserts IEEE_GET_FLAG reports quiet and IEEE_GET_ROUNDING_MODE returns IEEE_NEAREST. Underflow-status branch probes IEEE_SUPPORT_FLAG(IEEE_OVERFLOW,0.0) and IEEE_SUPPORT_UNDERFLOW_CONTROL(0.0); supported branch clears the flag and sets GRADUAL=.TRUE., saves status, sets the flag signaling and GRADUAL=.FALSE., restores status, then asserts the flag is quiet and IEEE_GET_UNDERFLOW_MODE returns .TRUE. Halting-status branch probes IEEE_SUPPORT_FLAG(IEEE_OVERFLOW,0.0) and IEEE_SUPPORT_HALTING(IEEE_OVERFLOW); supported branch clears the flag and sets halting .FALSE., saves status, sets the flag signaling and halting .FALSE. again, restores status, then asserts the flag is quiet and IEEE_GET_HALTING_MODE returns .FALSE.; unsupported branches record skip.
pending.status-variable-has-no-particular-flag-i: No portable runtime oracle can inspect internals of IEEE_STATUS_TYPE. Source-use plan: confirm the standard procedure summaries expose IEEE_GET_STATUS and IEEE_SET_STATUS only, with individual flag observation performed through IEEE_GET_FLAG rather than through the status object.
